query:
SELECT 
  MONTH(createdAt) as month,
  YEAR(createdAt) as year,
  COUNT(*) as total_items,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quantity > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as items_with_qty,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT productName) as product_names
FROM inventory 
WHERE (MONTH(createdAt) = 5 OR MONTH(createdAt) = 6) AND YEAR(createdAt) = 2026
GROUP BY MONTH(createdAt), YEAR(createdAt)
ORDER BY month;
